Fruit Punch Collagen Jelly 🍓🫐🍍 This is a unique one... Ingredients: • 1 cup pineapple juice • 1 cup cranberry juice • Juice of 1 lemon • Juice of 1 lime • 7 tbsp unflavored gelatin (I used beef gelatin) • 1–2 cups grapes • 1–2 cups strawberries • 1–2 cups blueberries How to Make It: 1. Use fresh or canned pineapple juice. For fresh juice, blend 1 cup pineapple with ½ cup water, then strain out the pulp. 2. Slice the strawberries and arrange the grapes, strawberries, and blueberries in a 9x9 baking dish or your preferred mold. 3. Add the pineapple juice, cranberry juice, lemon juice, and lime juice to a heat-safe bowl. 4. Heat the juice mixture in the microwave or on the stove until hot. 5. Whisk in the gelatin 1 tablespoon at a time, mixing well between each addition to prevent clumps. 6. Pour the mixture over the fruit. 7. Refrigerate for 4–8 hours, or until fully set. Longer is even better. **Approx. Macros (per serving, assuming 9 servings):** 🔥 95 calories 💪 5g protein 🥔 15g carbs 🥑 0g fat *Macros will vary depending on the amount of fruit, juice brand, and gelatin used.* Store in an airtight container in the fridge for 3–4 days.
